description: Rebecca has been a leading advocate and champion on maintaining affordable housing for the Upper East Side, Yorkville, and Roosevelt Island. Rebecca is a proud co-sponsor of Good Cause Eviction and strongly believes that tenants should not be subject to landlord harassment and rent increases. Rebecca is pushing for its passage this 2022 legislative session …
